snippet.title: How to reverse engineer Kissflow with Claude: what passed, what broke
snippet.description:
Claude built a Kissflow alternative from one Markdown spec: all 20 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 38 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 9 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for a small-team approval workflow for spend requests and had it build the tool in four phases: people and routing rules; requests, routing and decisions; notifications and approvals in Slack; and delegation, reminders, escalation and the CSV export. The gaps included escalation that could hand a step to someone who owned a later step, so they would approve the same request twice, reporting loops in Admin → People that break routing, and Slack approval times shown in UTC. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when Kissflow is still worth paying for.
